items.title: Get Ready for These Stocks to Move, Too
items.summary: If you're invested in telecoms, you need to put SpaceX's earnings report on your radar.  The disruption that SpaceX represents has been a stressor ever since June 12 -- SpaceX's IPO date--when company President Gwynne Shotwell told CNBC that the opportunity for Starlink Mobile was huge.  Shares bottomed out near $20 in early July, then recovered as SpaceX started to drop.

items.title: AT&T (T) Teams Up With Verizon And T Mobile On Glide.id Security
items.summary: AT&T (NYSE:T), T-Mobile, and Verizon have jointly enabled Glide.id's cryptographic authentication technology at the carrier network level. The collaboration targets rising AI-driven fraud by shifting from SMS-based logins to SIM-anchored cryptographic authentication. This move is intended to support passwordless authentication across services that rely on mobile identity verification.
